title: Operator on-ramp: skip pre-flight scope/tests_missing safety gate for open-ended agent plans

investigation.trigger: Platform owner: every Operator Console task fails, demanded 20-50 self-run test tasks
investigation.source: oasis_events (Supabase MCP execute_sql, read-only), real assistant.turn tool-call args compared against the model's own chat narration
investigation.key_finding: the model's chat narration of its retry (pasted by the user) did not match the actual tool-call arguments it sent; the real request prose never named a literal test file path, only a directory reference

root_cause: operator-execution-onramp.ts's triggerOperatorExecution() unconditionally runs approveAutoExecute()'s full pre-flight safety gate (via evaluateSafetyGate()) against files derived by extractFilePaths() scanning raw open-ended prose, even though the module's own doc comments already stated scope/tests_missing should be deferred to a post-hoc check on the agent's real diff (agent-scope.ts, VTID-04006) for open-ended plans. That deferral was never actually wired.

fix.mechanism: evaluateSafetyGate() skips rule 3 (scope) and rule 4 (tests_missing) when is_open_ended is true; approveAutoExecute() derives is_open_ended from rec.spec_snapshot.intake === 'open_ended'

live_verification: not performed — this session cannot authenticate as an Operator Console user (harness-level classifier block, unrelated to code); the next real signal is a live autopilot_run_task request against staging after deploy
